notes: Informs the SI6 baseline rather than pushing it: a large one-off industrial closure moves the number without evidencing systemic decarbonisation, and the distinction matters for how the 2024 data is read against Carbon Budget 4's zero-offset trajectory. Caught by the supersession pass of 22 July 2026 rather than collection, because the June CCC report predates the widened scan.
summary: The CCC's Progress in Reducing Emissions 2026 report to Parliament (24 June 2026) records that emissions in Wales fell significantly in 2024, with the reduction driven largely by the closure of the Port Talbot blast furnaces. The June 2026 devolved inventory carries the underlying figures.
title: CCC 2026 progress report: Welsh emissions fell significantly in 2024, driven by the Port Talbot closures
